messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm prepping the release notes + internal announce for tonight's runtime deploy. Draft is in the doc, want a 1-line ops blurb and pin owners. Change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC.
Simon: I can take announce. Will write the internal blurb and customer-facing one-liner.
Tara: I'll be primary rollback owner oncall for the window. Phone on, standby.
DeployBot: [deploy-scheduler] Job queued: runtime-gpu-pool:v2.8 -> canary @ 2026-03-21T22:05Z. Canary window 15m. Auto-rollback threshold: 0.5% errors OR p99 > 300ms.
Neal: Please highlight the KV-cache fix and batching regressions guardrail in the RN. That was noisy in staging.
Luis: Also add canary acceptance criteria explicitly: p99 latency < 250ms AND 10m error rate < 0.2%. Ops needs that for green check.
Simon: Draft blurb pasted below — PTAL and shorten if needed:
```
Internal: Runtime v2.8 deploy to canary tonight 22:05 UTC. Includes KV cache stability fix and batching guardrail to avoid token pump. Canary will run 15m; rollout to all after manual green. If canary fails, rollback to v2.7 will be triggered. Owners: Canary=Simon; Rollback=Tara; Eng-SRE=Neal.
Customer line: Minor runtime stabilization, no API changes.
```
Maya: Nice — can we add the pin matrix for docs and console? small table with routes pinned to v2.7 until 23:00 UTC?
Simon: Yup — plan to pin high-traffic routes (chat.stream, generation.sync) to v2.7 during canary. Will include instructions: `/pin-route chat.stream v2.7` in the RN.
Katie: Legal looked at the customer line, fine. For EU customers add: "no data residency changes" sentence.
Tara: FYI for rollback: quick steps below — keep it short in RN:
1) Pause new canary traffic
2) /rollback runtime-gpu-pool v2.7
3) Verify canary health then unpin routes
Neal: I'll autobump the alert thresholds for the window and monitor the traces. If p99 spikes but errors low we still abort.
Simon: I'll post the internal announce at t-15 and pin the RN in #eng-releases. Anyone want to review the final copy before I hit send at 21:50 UTC?
Maya: I'll proofread at 21:40 and add the deploybot snippet.
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: runtime-gpu-pool:v2.8 - canary starting in 1h  (notice sent to #eng-releases). :rocket:
